name: libcu++
listed_description: The NVIDIA C++ Standard Library, providing heterogeneous implementation of C++ Standard Library facilities.
reason: No numeric comparison reachable. Repo is archived (2024-03-21) and merged into NVIDIA/cccl; README is a stub pointing to docs/overview.md, which has no performance claims, and CHANGELOG.md has none. benchmarks/concurrency.cpp times cuda::barrier, cuda::latch and mutexes against pthread_barrier, OpenMP barrier and std::mutex, but the repo publishes no results and states no hardware. NVIDIA blog (developer.nvidia.com) unreachable (DNS failure) and two WebSearch queries found no figures.

name: libhl
listed_description: Library implementing a thread-safe API to manage a range of data
reason: No benchmarks anywhere reachable. README has no performance claim beyond the About text 'Simple and fast C library'; test/ holds functional tests only (hashtable_test.c etc.); a WebSearch for comparisons against uthash, GLib or Concurrency Kit found none. Directional claim without numbers.

name: log4cplus
listed_description: A simple to use C++ logging API providing thread-safe, flexible, and arbitrarily granular control over log management and configuration.
reason: No numeric comparison against any baseline. README and ChangeLog carry no timing claims; tests/performance_test/ is an internal smoke test (performance_test.at only checks for exit code and an initialisation warning) with no baseline. Third-party shootouts checked (MuggleWei/cc_log_benchmark, mattiasflodin/reckless doc/performance.md, RafaGago/logger-bench) do not include log4cplus; three WebSearch queries found no published log4cplus numbers.

name: Log4cpp
listed_description: A library of C++ classes for flexible logging to files, syslog, IDSA and other destinations.
reason: No numeric comparison. Project page has only qualitative remarks (release 0.3.3 'new, faster and more complete' PatternLayout; zero runtime overhead when messages are compiled out) with no numbers or baseline. It appears only as a slow competitor target (spdlog bench/log4cpp-bench.cpp) and not in MuggleWei/cc_log_benchmark, Reckless or logger-bench result tables; searches found no published figures.

name: logfault
listed_description: A simple, elegant and efficient C++ header-only logging library.
reason: No numeric comparison. README says it is 'optimized for moderate log-volumes' and that std::stream use is 'relatively slow compared to raw buffer-based IO'; doc/ holds only control_wrappers.md. Not present in MuggleWei/cc_log_benchmark, Reckless performance.md or logger-bench; a WebSearch found no benchmark including logfault.
